title: Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku: restart

thread.title: Magical Girl Raising Project restart • Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku restart - Episode 1 discussion

opinions.point: Longtime viewers were enthusiastic about the return after the decade-long wait and generally excited about the premiere.
Many commenters liked the character designs, personalities, and large variety of magical-girl concepts.
The opening and ending music received favorable reactions, including praise for the vocal performances.
The episode introduces a very large cast quickly; some found that exciting, while others worried that the adaptation may need to slow down later.
Several viewers found the episode engaging and easy enough to follow, even while noting that prior familiarity with the original series adds context.
At least one comparison found the available video quality disappointing despite preferring that release's translation.

title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.

thread.title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! • Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu. - Episode 1 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters found the premiere charming, cozy, funny, and more entertaining than expected.
Rose was widely liked for her flustered, earnest, and comedic personality, with several people eager to watch more of her relationship with Harij.
Several commenters praised the attractive art, backgrounds, and generally solid animation.
The opening and ending were viewed favorably for their soothing, romantic, and wistful atmosphere.
Some enjoyed the blend of melancholy and comedy, while others worried that the central romantic premise could become repetitive or overly painful.
A minority strongly disliked the ethical implications of love potions and rejected the heroine’s willingness to make them, with one commenter dropping the series almost immediately.
Some viewers found the heroine’s prolonged unrequited feelings uncomfortable or difficult to watch.
